provider: GitVerse (Sber git hosting: LFS + releases + packages)

free_tier.stated: 2 GB Git LFS per user AND per org (monthly), 4 GB release assets per user/org, 500 MB packages per user/org

egress.terms: free clone/download from the platform, no egress billing published

tooling: standard git + git-lfs over HTTPS/SSH; registries for npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, NuGet, Docker, Generic, Helm, deb, rpm
chaining: caps are per user/org TOTAL, not per repo — unlimited repos x 4 GB does NOT multiply. Only new orgs/users do: 4 GB per org. 20 TiB would need 5 000 orgs.
limits_note: 2 GB LFS/mo; 4 GB releases; 500 MB packages; 100 MB per file via HTTP, 1 GB via SSH; max 5 files and 500 MB per release upload batch
reliability_note: Hard global caps per identity with no top-up path; exceeding them blocks new uploads entirely rather than throttling. Quota stays with the original owner after repo transfer.
